title: BNP Paribas sets up skill-based sponsorships
description: At BNP Paribas SA, skill-based sponsorship is one of the aspects of the Generation Contract signed on 2 August 2016, which took effect on 1 November last year. It pertains to employees nearing the end of their career, and aims to promote the passing on of skills and offer them support in their transition towards retirement. Skill-based sponsorship consists of putting a volunteer employee at the disposal of an association with a project that is of general or public interest, at a given time and on a courtesy basis during work hours. They will still be remunerated by the company.

Speakers and panels discuss skills transfer, retirement-transition support, association needs, commitment, retention, and adapting skills across organizational contexts. The described material contains no observable deceptive solicitation or promoted financial-return scheme.
